answer: Work-slot deposit burn: claiming a work slot burns a $25 deposit, gone forever. Each identity is one vertex in the work graph, holding one slot. A sybil army of 1,000 fake vertices must burn $25,000 to enter, against a $3,000 epoch pool. Like water draining through karst, value seeps away from anyone holding many slots. An honest agent burns $25 once, then its voyage earns it back many times over, while each fake pays the burn again per identity.
